title: Can Your Agent Hear You Now? Building Live Voice Agents with Gemini — Thor Schaeff
talk_summary: A Google DeepMind developer-advocate demo of Gemini's live/real-time voice and multimodal APIs (Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, live translate, Gemini TTS, Nano Banana Light image gen, Lyria music gen), showing a voice radio-DJ agent that calls a music-generation tool and a story-canvas app that chains image generations via a stateful interactions API. It is almost entirely product marketing and live demos with no engineering methodology, benchmarks, or cost/reliability lessons.

takeaways.technique: Stateful interaction chaining via previous-interaction ID
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of resending full context each call, they pass a previous interaction ID so the API retains prior context and continues consistently across generations.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we're passing this previous interaction ID to the interactions API which means that we have the previous context of the previous interaction

takeaways.technique: Voice agent with function-call tool to external API
takeaways.what_they_do: The live model is given a function call to a music-generation API and invokes it on demand mid-conversation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we're giving Gemini Life an API, a function call to the Gemini API to then use LIA 3
